name: YouTube
description: Search, open, and control playback of YouTube videos.
author: WebMCP Anywhere

tools.name: yt_search
tools.title: Search YouTube
tools.description: Navigate to the YouTube search results page for a query. The page will reload; afterwards call yt_play_result with an index (1 = first result) to open a video. Returns the results URL that was opened.

query.description: Search terms, e.g. "lofi hip hop radio".

tools.name: yt_list_results
tools.title: List search results
tools.description: On a YouTube search results page, read the visible video results. Returns `titles` (array, in on-page order, index 1 = first), `urls` (matching watch URLs) and `channels`. Use the 1-based position with yt_play_result.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-50).

actions.selector: ytd-video-renderer ytd-channel-name a, ytd-video-renderer ytd-channel-name yt-formatted-string

tools.name: yt_play_result
tools.title: Open a search result
tools.description: On a YouTube search results page, click the N-th video result (1 = first) to open its watch page. The page navigates to the video and starts playing. Returns the clicked title in `did`.

index.description: 1-based position of the result to open.

tools.name: yt_play
tools.title: Play
tools.description: Start (or resume) playback of the current YouTube video. Returns the player `media` state: {paused, currentTime, duration, playbackRate, volume, muted}.

tools.name: yt_pause
tools.title: Pause
tools.description: Pause the current YouTube video. Returns the player `media` state: {paused, currentTime, duration, playbackRate, volume, muted}.

tools.name: yt_toggle_play
tools.title: Play/pause
tools.description: Toggle between playing and paused for the current YouTube video. Returns the resulting `media` state.

tools.name: yt_seek
tools.title: Seek to time
tools.description: Jump to an absolute position in the current YouTube video, in seconds from the start (clamped to the video duration). Returns the `media` state including the new currentTime.

seconds.description: Absolute position in seconds, e.g. 90 for 1:30.

tools.name: yt_skip
tools.title: Skip forward/back
tools.description: Skip relative to the current position of the YouTube video. Positive seconds skip forward, negative seconds rewind (e.g. -10). Returns the `media` state including the new currentTime.

seconds.description: Offset in seconds; negative to rewind.

tools.name: yt_set_speed
tools.title: Set playback speed
tools.description: Set the playback rate of the current YouTube video (1 = normal, 1.5, 2, 0.5 ...). Returns the `media` state including playbackRate.

tools.name: yt_set_volume
tools.title: Set volume
tools.description: Set the player volume of the current YouTube video, 0 (silent) to 1 (full). Unmutes if volume > 0. Returns the `media` state.

tools.name: yt_toggle_mute
tools.title: Mute/unmute
tools.description: Toggle mute on the current YouTube video. Returns the `media` state including `muted`.

tools.name: yt_toggle_captions
tools.title: Toggle captions
tools.description: Toggle closed captions/subtitles on the current YouTube video by clicking the CC button. Returns `captions_on` ("true"/"false" from the button's aria-pressed attribute).

tools.name: yt_toggle_fullscreen
tools.title: Toggle fullscreen
tools.description: Toggle fullscreen mode for the YouTube player by clicking the fullscreen button. Returns the button's current label in `button` (e.g. "Full screen" or "Exit full screen").

tools.name: yt_toggle_theater
tools.title: Toggle theater mode
tools.description: Toggle theater (wide) mode for the YouTube player. Returns the size button's current label in `button`.

tools.name: yt_next
tools.title: Next video
tools.description: Skip to the next video (autoplay/playlist next) by clicking the player's Next button. The page navigates to the next video. Returns the run log in `did`.

tools.name: yt_now_playing
tools.title: Now playing
tools.description: Read what is currently playing on the YouTube watch page. Returns `title`, `channel`, `url` and the player `media` state {paused, currentTime, duration, playbackRate, volume, muted}. Does not change playback.

actions.selector: ytd-watch-metadata #owner ytd-channel-name a, #owner #channel-name a, ytd-channel-name a

tools.name: yt_related
tools.title: List related videos
tools.description: On a YouTube watch page, list the related/up-next videos in the sidebar. Returns `titles` and `urls` arrays (index 1 = first). Use yt_open_url or navigate to play one.
